lines.say: At the end of Metroid, players found out the hero was a woman the whole time.
Metroid came out in Japan in 1986, and in America in 1987.
Beat it fast enough, and Samus takes off her helmet. A huge surprise for players back then.
The movie Alien was a huge influence, and the boss Ridley is named after director Ridley Scott.
The name mixes metro and android.
And the password Justin Bailey lets you play without the suit.
lines.cap: And the password JUSTIN BAILEY lets you play without the suit.

lines.say: Did you know Samus was a woman? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
